claims.statement: Red Leary offered to bet on a fresh fight for $1,000 a side, and Tom Allen declined because he said he could not have fair play.

claims.statement: Tom Allen published a card in the Cincinnati evening papers saying fair play was impossible in this country and announcing his withdrawal from the ring.

fights.excerpt: I give this fight to Goss on the ground
fights.notes: Awarded to Goss on a foul by referee Eph Holland; Allen's side disputed it and Red Leary offered a rematch. Stopped by Kentucky militia in round 7, then resumed at the farm. Day not printed; month inferred from the 8 September card.

notes: Reprinted from the Cincinnati Enquirer. Fight date is not printed; 1876-09 is inferred.
